services.desc: Big changes start with one small step-and we’re with you all the way. With expert coaching and a welcoming community, your transformation starts here. Trying a new gym shouldn’t be a big deal, and you don't have to be fit to start! Our Coaches meet you where you are, and will help you define your fitness goals-come experience the CrossFit Lobo difference for yourself! Your trial class will be guided by one of our expert coaches, and you'll get to chat with other athletes and coaches to see if our gym is a fit for you! blurb: Welcome! Here at CrossFit Lobo, we offer semi-private group fitness training of the CrossFit Methodology. What is CrossFit? In a nutshell, CrossFit is Constantly Varied, High Intensity, Functional Movement. We Train for a lifetime of fitness and health. Whether you're a competitive athlete, gym enthusiast or complete beginner, we have a workout for you.
